headline: Land Sale Revenue: Fell from the Ceiling to the Floor, What Will Localities Do?
summary: Land sale revenue for Chinese local governments has fallen from a high level to a low one. The report asks how localities will respond to the drop in this income source.
why: Land sales have long been a major revenue source for Chinese local governments, which fund infrastructure and debt service. Weaker land revenue affects local government finances and the property sector.
